hypothesis: On 16-register AVX2, the generic Q8_0 x Q8_0 dispatcher handles an exact four-column matrix as two 4-row x 2-column tiles. That streams every large Q8 weight block twice. For the selected n=4 family, two 2-row x 4-column tiles stream each weight block once and re-read only the tiny activation panel. Existing gemmMx4<2> uses the same Q8 codes, scale products, integer dot products, per-output l order, and hsum, so the orientation change should be bit-exact while approaching a two-fold subkernel speedup in a bandwidth-bound regime.

candidate.base: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order v1 and promoted fused one-to-three-row v2
required_scope: tinyBLAS_Q0_AVX instantiated with TA=block_q8_0 and TB=block_q8_0 only
route mc=2,nc=4 to gemmMx4<2> instead of mc=4,nc=2 to gemm4xN<2>
forbidden_changes: quantized values, scales, or tensor layouts
per-output integer dot-product or floating accumulation order

stop_rules: Reject before real-model timing if any selected backend output differs from the control.
Reject before generation if graph speedup is below eight percent or process medians are unstable.
Reject before CUTE if any committed token or aggregate draft count differs from control.
Do not use instrumented profile-build timings as a score.
claim_boundary: A pass would promote one exact AVX2 Q8 tile-orientation optimization for Qwen3.8-27B MTP verification on four Milan cores. It would not satisfy the trained approximation, final-node, energy, 100 accepted tok/s, or novelty gates.
